info.title: Quilia Universal API
info.description: Quilia is a HIPAA-compliant client manager for law firms. It helps firms remind clients about appointments, track treatment, collect documents, and sync client activity with case management systems.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

caseId.description: The case ID to associate with the appointment. Links the appointment to a specific legal case or matter.

contactId.description: The contact/people ID associated with the appointment. Identifies the person involved in the appointment. Optional for legal appointments.

notes.description: Additional notes or details about the appointment. Can include agenda items, special instructions, or other relevant information.

title.description: Title/name of the appointment. Recommended for legal appointments.

userId.description: The user ID to assign the appointment to. If provided, this user will be responsible for the appointment.

start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the appointment starts. Must be a valid datetime string.

end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the appointment ends. Required for legal appointments.

type.description: Type of appointment: 'medical' for medical appointments, 'legal' for legal calendar events.
